activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and showering
Preparing and eating breakfast, making coffee with the kettle
Getting dressed in work clothes, packing work bag, and checking phone for shift notes
Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
Working as a health care professional: patient assessments, medication administration, and clinical documentation
Taking a lunch break at work
Continuing clinical duties: patient care, handover notes, and coordinating with the care team
Cooking and eating dinner, then loading dishes into the dishwasher
Cleaning the countertops and putting away leftovers in the refrigerator
Sorting laundry and running the washing machine
Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
Taking an evening shower and drying clothes
Winding down: reading and dimming the desk lamp before bed
